about_the_game:
Fly weird. Fight smart. Crash often.

Off the Beaten Track is a local multiplayer arcade action game where charismatic pilots fly on machines and clash in fast-paced aerial arenas. Pick your favorite fighter, hop into a bizarre aircraft, and prove to your friends who's the true aerial ace.

Whether you're just here to mess around with friends or to show off your next-level piloting skills, this game has room for both. The controls are easy to pick up, but mastering the skies? That’s a whole different story.

With reactive arenas, unpredictable interactions, and plenty of room for both laughter and outplays, Off the Beaten Track delivers action that’s lighthearted on the surface — but with surprising depth if you dig in.

Play locally with up to 4 players in chaotic, couch-fueled fun — perfect for parties, rivalries, and spontaneous laughter. With crazy gadgets, interactive environments, and unpredictable mayhem, every match is a new adventure full of explosions, shouting, and cartoon-style carnage.

Casual fun or competitive flair — the choice is yours. Just don’t expect anything to go as planned once you're Off the Beaten Track.

  • Local multiplayer mayhem for up to 4 players

  • 10 unique pilots and customizable flying machines

  • Accessible arcade-style controls with skill-based depth

  • 10 dynamic arenas full of hazards, tricks, and power-ups

  • A playful, stylized world that doesn’t take itself too seriously

  • Perfect for party nights or sweaty 1v1 grudge matches
